name: thaana-pdf-to-word

author: Thaana PDF to Word

scripts.test:app: node scripts/vendor.mjs && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --features smoke,tauri/custom-protocol --target-dir src-tauri/target/smoke && node test/tauri-smoke.mjs
